	We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Microsoft Windows and VMware vSphere Administrator to join our Infrastructure and Operations team.

		VMware Storage vMotion

	Perform virtualization capacity planning and performance optimization.
	Ensure high availability and resilience of virtualization platforms.

	Manage Azure virtual machines, storage, and identity services.
	Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
	Implement cloud governance, security, and operational best practices.
	Infrastructure Security and Compliance

	Remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities and security findings.
	Support Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives.
	Collaborate with Cyber Security teams to strengthen infrastructure security.
	Ensure compliance with corporate IT, audit, and regulatory requirements.
	Monitoring a n d Performance Management
	Administer infrastructure monitoring and alerting platforms.
	Proactively monitor infrastructure health and system availability.
	Perform root cause analysis for major incidents.
	Identify and implement performance improvements.
	Support problem management and continuous service improvement initiatives.

	Develop automation solutions using:
	
		PowerShell
		VMware PowerCLI

	Standardize operational procedures and deployment activities.

		Infrastructure refresh programs

	Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior administrators and engineers.
	Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams and external vendors.
	Produce and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and operational runbooks.
	Support audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting requirements.
	Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure and virtualization issues.

	Maintain secure, compliant, and resilient&nbsp;Windows and VMware environments.

	Conduct code reviews and maintain high standards for code quality, security, and development practices.
